claim: For Db2, MariaDB, MySQL and PostgreSQL gp3 volumes of 400–65,536 GiB, the baseline is 12,000 IOPS/500 MiB/s, and you can provision 12,000–64,000 IOPS and 500–4,000 MiB/s of throughput.
question: How far can provisioned IOPS and throughput go on a large RDS gp3 volume for MySQL or PostgreSQL?

values.spoken: twelve thousand IOPS and five hundred mebibytes per second
twelve thousand to sixty-four thousand IOPS
five hundred to four thousand mebibytes per second

qualifiers.scope: per DB instance (gp3; Db2, MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
qualifiers.condition: at or above the 400 GiB threshold
